items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I knew one of the guys that had been on the Al G. Barnes Circus named Jug Everly... So I sent him a telegram. And he said, sure he could use me

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, Prohibition was on... This was in 1925! Because I didn't stay on that medicine show too long. It had to be '25... Yeah. Because I remember when I got to New Orleans, the World Series was on, the 1925 World Series, the Yankees and somebody... [SIC: In 1925, the Washington Senators played the Pittsburgh Pirates. So maybe it was 1926.]

Anyway, I seen in a Billboard the Al G. Barnes Circus was looking for musicians. They was playing in Cincinnati. So it just happened I knew one of the guys that had been on the Al G. Barnes Circus named Jug Everly, a trombone player out of Los Angeles here. So I sent him a telegram. And he said, sure he could use me; join the circus in Cincinnati.
Was he the director of the band, or what?
